tools.trigger_when: public YouTube discovery/captions/comments; public media metadata/subtitles; or authorized non-YouTube extraction
yt-dlp requires local EJS challenge execution
explicitly authorized non-YouTube audio normalization is needed
outputs: temporary 16 kHz mono WAV and media metadata

tools.trigger_when: authorized non-YouTube audio has no usable subtitles and both audio fallback gates are true
authorized whisper.cpp audio fallback is enabled
RSS/Atom/sitemap parsing, YouTube result normalization/ranking/selection, comment review ranking or provenance validation is needed

boundaries: Only public HTTP(S) sources and accountless public YouTube discovery; no login, cookie, credential, DRM, paywall, CAPTCHA or age-control bypass.

Public YouTube captions, metadata and public comments may be collected anonymously without a separate prior-written-permission or applicable-law execution attestation; a supplied access-basis value is provenance metadata only.
An upstream public-YouTube anti-bot/access denial is reported as access_blocked evidence; the runtime does not answer it by enabling cookies, login, proxying or media fallback.
Public YouTube is captions, metadata and optional public comments only; audio/video download and Whisper fallback are blocked.
Public GitHub runs may persist bounded task-scoped transcript/comment analysis artifacts when analysis_content_allowed=true; this does not authorize republication or reuse.
Automatic YouTube caption choice is English, then Dutch, then the first other available language; manual captions beat automatic captions within the same language.
Auto-translated YouTube caption variants are rejected using yt-dlp translated_subs skipping plus a local tlang URL guard for known metadata edge cases.
WebVTT/SRT normalization strips metadata, timestamps and markup and collapses rolling auto-caption overlap before analysis.
channel_all combines the public videos, shorts and streams tabs and deduplicates overlapping video IDs before selection; channel_streams is also directly addressable.
YouTube rankings and random selection are relative to the fetched candidate set and must not be presented as global coverage of all YouTube.
sort_by=random uses request_id as a reproducible pseudo-random seed so identical requests are auditable while new request IDs can produce a new draw.
Bounded YouTube work has explicit item, scan, per-item comment and total comment budgets; larger requests require explicit allow_unbounded and still remain under hard runtime caps.
max_comments=all is best-effort for comments exposed to yt-dlp/YouTube, is limited to at most five selected items, and never proves global comment completeness.

Persisted public-comment evidence minimizes direct commenter identity fields and redacts obvious email, phone, URL and handle patterns before persistence; remaining text is still untrusted task-scoped evidence.
Knowledge-oriented comment ranking is candidate triage only: it uses explainable engagement/creator/pinned/keyword signals and never promotes a comment to project truth without semantic owner review.
Every executed request must exactly match this toolkit-contract source_set_version; placeholders and stale concrete versions are rejected.
analysis_content_allowed permits task-scoped analysis/paraphrase artifacts and does not imply reuse rights; reuse_allowed remains separately gated by rights_basis.
Non-YouTube Whisper fallback requires allow_audio_fallback=true, audio_access_authorized=true and a concrete authorization/rights_basis.
Raw source content is never automatically project truth; webactueel-workflow owns quality, currentness, deduplication and knowledge promotion.
All output is at most controlled_runtime evidence.
